sheets.prompt:
STYLE: 1930s rubber hose cartoon, hand-inked cel animation look, original characters.
Thick uniform outline in dark plum #3D3346 on every shape, clean confident lines, no sketchy strokes.
Flat cel colors with at most one soft shade tone per color, no gradients on characters, no 3D rendering, no glossy plastic look; one small white highlight dot is allowed.
Characters: bendy rubber hose arms and legs with no elbows or knees, white four-finger cartoon gloves, big round shoes, pie-cut eyes (black ovals with a small wedge cut out), simple wide mouth, big head-to-body ratio.
Character colors are saturated: red #D2463C, blue #3E6DB5, yellow #F2C14E, cream #F4E6C8, glove white #FBF6EA.
Backgrounds and large props look like faded watercolor on paper in beige #CFAC8D, sand #D7BE97, dusty navy #4E546E, muted olive #8A9A6B, warm grey #907F77, and are LESS saturated than the characters.
Soft light from the top-left. No cast shadow on the ground. No text, letters or numbers anywhere.
Do not copy any existing cartoon or game character, logo, or scene.

Each item isolated on a flat solid #FF00FF magenta background (or transparent), full figure visible, nothing cropped, wide empty margin around every item, no ground line, no floor, no frame, no border, no shadow under the item.
Characters face the viewer at a slight high 3/4 angle unless a direction is given. "Side" always means facing RIGHT.

GRAMO: an old wooden gramophone, grandfather character.
Square cabinet body in reddish-brown wood #8B4A2F with cream #F4E6C8 trim; the cabinet front is his face with pie-cut eyes and a white bushy moustache.
A big brass flower-shaped horn #F2C14E rises from the top like a hat. A wind-up crank handle sticks out of his right side.
Short rubber hose legs with black round shoes, rubber hose arms with white gloves.

Use the supplied style_anchor.png as the PRIMARY original character design and line/color reference. The other two supplied images are SUPPORTING inking and vintage-cartoon style references only: do not copy their characters, logos or scenes.
Create one clean production sprite sheet. Pure flat #FF00FF magenta background across the entire sheet, including gaps enclosed by limbs. Do not use magenta anywhere inside the character. Flat cel fills with one restrained shade, no gradients or paper grain. Exactly the requested full-body poses, in one horizontal row, evenly spaced in separate equal-width invisible cells. Wide blank margins on all four sides, at least 100px clear gaps between silhouettes. Baseline aligned. Character artwork at least 500px tall. No labels, no title, no palette circles, no border, no floor, no cast shadows, no extra particles. All poses must depict the SAME character with identical facial structure, proportions and equipment; only expression and pose change.

Wide landscape 3:2 sheet with THREE poses. Match the two gramophone characters in the anchor. Left: exhausted with visibly drooping flower horn, heavy half-closed eyes, dangling hands and slumped stance. Center: awake, horn fully raised/open, waving the hand on viewer's left, kicking the foot on viewer's right. Right: a second awake dance beat, wave the hand on viewer's right and kick the foot on viewer's left, tilt horn the opposite direction. Keep cabinet design and crank on its same physical side rather than literally mirroring the cabinet. Clear white bushy moustache on all three. Both awake poses have pie-cut eyes and broad smiles.

Manifest pose prompts, left to right:
1. GRAMO the old gramophone, run-down and sleepy: brass horn drooping down like a wilted flower, half-closed heavy eyelids, mouth hanging open, arms dangling, slumped on short legs
2. GRAMO the old gramophone, fully wound up and joyful: brass horn standing tall and wide open, big pie-cut eyes wide open, huge grin, one white-gloved arm waving, dancing on one leg
3. GRAMO dancing, mirrored pose of the awake pose: other arm up, other leg kicked out, horn tilted the other way
